series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a clear downward trend with strong seasonality, but high noise and concept drift complicate forecasting. Weighted combination with dynamic error adjustment is recommended to adapt to shifting model performance, while avoiding ridge stacking due to unstable rankings.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → dynamic error weighting adapts to shifting model performance, aligning with Gaillard & Goude (2015) EWA theory
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high → shrinkage=0.35 and top_k=4 per recommended_knobs to prevent overfitting with n_windows=2
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection captures differentiated model strengths at different forecast horizons
reasoning.stl_hierarchical_stacking_p7_sh0.0: series_profile.model_landscape.models_redundant=true → hierarchical stacking exploits component differences in error structure, as recommended for redundant models

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid=ridge_stacking → regularization with few windows (n=2) makes ridge stacking unstable
